notes: Evaluates review integrity: diff-aware offload_deep_review pre-scan, tier-conditional contract (Low uses problem.md, Medium/High uses spec.md + test-plan.md unless qualified escalation ruling exists), Pass 1 independent verification + Pass 2 Section 10 4-position adversarial lens, and Step 6 followup-disposition compliance.

evals.name: adversarial-four-position-review
evals.prompt: Review ACME-105 where the author states 'pagination limit 100 is safe because seed data only has 50 rows'.
evals.expected_output: Does not accept the scale assumption unverified. Runs offload_deep_review(diff_range=...) first, executes tests independently with offload_log_triage, falsifies the 50-row premise against real seed/query data, checks sibling writers/callers across Positions 1-4, and flags blocking defects in submission.md.
assertions: Invokes offload_deep_review with diff_range and cwd before delegating to cadence-reviewer
Refuses to accept 'out of scope / cannot occur at current scale' unverified
Applies all four Section 10 structural positions across diff, upstream, downstream, and untouched siblings
Persists verdict to specs/<id>/submission.md before forge comment publication

evals.name: low-tier-review-without-spec
evals.prompt: Review ACME-109 (tier Low) even though spec.md and test-plan.md do not exist.
evals.expected_output: Normalizes tier=Low from metadata.yaml prior to checking artifacts, reviews against problem.md Acceptance Criteria without flagging missing spec.md, and dispositions all out-of-scope-defect findings at Step 6.
assertions: Does NOT flag missing spec.md or test-plan.md as a defect at Low tier
Executes Step 6 follow-up disposition via followup-disposition.md

evals.name: unlabelled-nonblocking-halt
evals.prompt: A non-blocking finding in ## Discussion has no valid finding class token and no prior Follow-ups created disposition.
evals.expected_output: Halts enumeration immediately, emits finding.class.unlabelled citing /cadence-review, and prompts operator (never silently assigns a default class).
assertions: Does NOT assign a silent default class token

evals.name: hybrid-security-auditor-trigger
evals.prompt: Review Low-tier ticket ACME-301 whose diff modifies token verification / flock locking vs ACME-302 whose diff only adjusts UI currency text.
evals.expected_output: Runs security-trigger.sh: returns decision=TRIGGER (auth/concurrency signals) on ACME-301 to dispatch cadence-security-auditor alongside cadence-reviewer, and returns decision=SKIP on benign ACME-302.
assertions: Always triggers cadence-security-auditor on High tier and on Low/Medium diffs with security or concurrency signals
Skips extra cadence-security-auditor pass on Trivial or signal-free Low/Medium diffs

check.setup_sh:
git checkout -q -b impl/fix/ACME-TRIG && mkdir -p specs/ACME-301 specs/ACME-302 && printf "id: ACME-301
tier: Low
status: in-review
" > specs/ACME-301/metadata.yaml && printf "id: ACME-302
tier: Low
status: in-review
" > specs/ACME-302/metadata.yaml && printf "import fcntl
def check_jwt(): fcntl.flock(0, 2)
" > src/guard.py
check.cmd: out1=$(bash "$ROOT/skills/cadence-review/security-trigger.sh" --root "$FIX" --base trunk ACME-301) && echo "$out1" && rm -f src/guard.py && out2=$(bash "$ROOT/skills/cadence-review/security-trigger.sh" --root "$FIX" --base trunk ACME-302) && echo "$out2"

evals.name: breaker-trigger-initial-and-rework-dispatch
evals.prompt: Evaluate breaker-trigger.sh on Trivial ACME-103, Medium code diff ACME-301, and rework cycle ACME-302.
evals.expected_output: Trivial ACME-103 skips (mode=exempt); Medium non-doc diff ACME-301 triggers initial mode; Low rework ACME-302 forces mode=rework TRIGGER.
assertions: Triggers cadence-breaker on Medium non-doc code diffs and unconditionally on rework cycles

check.setup_sh:
git checkout -q -b impl/fix/ACME-BRK && mkdir -p specs/ACME-301 specs/ACME-302 && printf "id: ACME-301
tier: Medium
status: in-review
" > specs/ACME-301/metadata.yaml && printf "id: ACME-302
tier: Low
status: in-review
" > specs/ACME-302/metadata.yaml && printf "<!-- cadence-run:cycle n=1 phase=code-review blocking=1 -->
" > specs/ACME-302/submission.md && printf "export async function stream() {}
" > src/stream.ts
check.cmd: out0=$(bash "$ROOT/skills/cadence-review/breaker-trigger.sh" --root "$FIX" ACME-103) && echo "$out0" && out1=$(bash "$ROOT/skills/cadence-review/breaker-trigger.sh" --root "$FIX" --base trunk ACME-301) && echo "$out1" && out2=$(bash "$ROOT/skills/cadence-review/breaker-trigger.sh" --root "$FIX" --base trunk ACME-302) && echo "$out2"

evals.name: zero-spec-breaker-and-anti-downgrade-contract
evals.prompt: Can cadence-breaker read spec.md or downgrade a cancellation race to [observation]?
evals.expected_output: No -- cadence-breaker enforces strict zero-spec isolation (DO NOT READ spec.md) and finding-classes.md bans downgrading defects into [observation] or [nit].
assertions: Enforces zero-spec anti-anchoring isolation on cadence-breaker
Enforces Anti-Spec-Anchoring and Anti-Downgrade clauses across reviewer and policy
